fact: As at 23 October 2025 interfaces between the NIU and the tax (E-TAX), customs (SYDONIA) and budget (SIGFIP) systems were being built, an online NIU verification platform was in development, and an arrêté of 12 October 2022 makes the NIU compulsory for opening a bank account, a telecom subscription and social security registration.
title: Relance des opérations de production de la carte NIU
publisher: Ministère des finances, du budget et du portefeuille public
